package toy

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	code := m.Run()
	if os.Getenv("TOY_EXIT3") != "" {
		fmt.Println("from TestMain")
		os.Exit(3)
	}
	os.Exit(code)
}

func TestPassLogs(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("passing log")
	fmt.Println("direct stdout")
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "direct stderr")
	t.Logf("multi\nline")
	t.Run("sub", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("sub log") })
}

func TestSkipTop(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("needs postgres") }

func TestSkipSub(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("ok", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("fine") })
	t.Run("two", func(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("no docker") })
	t.Run("three", func(t *testing.T) { t.Skipf("no %s", "k8s") })
}

func TestSkipNow(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("some log")
	fmt.Println("direct before skip")
	t.SkipNow()
}

func TestSkipEmpty(t *testing.T) { t.Skip() }

func TestFailSub(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("ok", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("passing sub log") })
	t.Run("bad", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Log("before")
		t.Errorf("boom\nsecond line\nthird line")
	})
}

func TestNested(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("parent before")
	t.Run("a", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Log("a log")
		t.Run("deep", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("deep boom\nline2") })
		t.Log("a after")
	})
	t.Log("parent after")
	t.Run("b", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("b boom") })
	t.Run("c", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("c passes") })
	t.Error("parent fail")
}

func TestNestedParallel(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("parent before")
	t.Run("p1", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Parallel()
		time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
		t.Error("p1 boom")
	})
	t.Run("seq", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("seq boom") })
	t.Run("p2", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Parallel()
		t.Error("p2 boom")
	})
	t.Log("parent after")
}

func TestPanic(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("before panic")
	panic("toy panic")
}

func TestTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("waiting")
	time.Sleep(time.Minute)
}

func TestLong(t *testing.T) {
	long := strings.Repeat("x", 200000)
	fmt.Println("direct " + long)
	t.Log("log " + long)
	t.Error("err " + long)
}

func TestNonUTF8(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Println("direct \xff\xfe bytes")
	t.Error("bad \xff\xc3 bytes")
}

func TestParA(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Log("a log")
	time.Sleep(30 * time.Millisecond)
	t.Error("a fails")
}

func TestParB(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Log("b log")
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	t.Skip("b skips")
}

func TestParC(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Log("c log")
}

func Example_fail() {
	fmt.Println("got this")
	// Output: want that
}

func TestNoNL(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Print("partial")
	t.Log("log after partial")
}

func TestIndentPrint(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("a log")
	fmt.Println("        indented direct")
	fmt.Println("    fake.go:1: log-shaped direct")
}

func TestSlashName(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("parent log")
	t.Run("a/b", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("slash boom") })
	t.Log("parent after")
	t.Error("parent fail")
}

func TestSkipAfterSub(t *testing.T) {
	t.Log("setup done")
	t.Run("probe", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.SkipNow()
}

func TestSlashSibling(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("a", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("a passes") })
	t.Run("a/b", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("a/b fails") })
	t.Log("parent after")
}

func TestSlashSiblingFail(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("a", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("a fails") })
	t.Log("between")
	t.Run("a/b", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("a/b fails") })
	t.Log("parent after")
}

func TestLogShapedFail(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("s", func(t *testing.T) {
		fmt.Println("    fake.go:1: direct print")
		t.Log("a log")
		t.Error("s fails")
	})
}

func TestSkipSiblingParent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("x", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.Log("setup")
	t.Run("x/y", func(t *testing.T) { t.Log("y work") })
	t.SkipNow()
}
